original_ai_output.title_zh: 移动实验室加快刚果（金）东部埃博拉检测速度
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 在刚果（金）东部，移动实验室已运行两周，帮助疫情重灾区医护人员更快获得埃博拉检测结果。在布滕博的一处实验室，样本可现场检测，且整个设施可随时转移至其他社区应对紧急情况。

location.raw_text: Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）东部移动实验室已运行两周，加快埃博拉检测
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In eastern Congo, mobile laboratories are helping health workers get Ebola test results much faster in some of the outbreak’s hardest-hit areas.

key_facts.fact: 布滕博的实验室可现场检测样本，且设施可随时转移
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At a lab in Butembo, samples can now be tested on site — and the entire facility can be moved quickly if another community faces an emergency.

key_facts.fact: 此前获取检测结果需72小时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: getting a test result used to take 72 hours

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证
